items.title: Trade Desk (TTD) Opens Direct Brand Lift Measurement Inside Its Core Ad Platform
items.summary: Trade Desk (NasdaqGM:TTD) is adding LoopMe Limited to its Measurement Marketplace, giving advertisers direct access to scalable Brand Lift measurement inside the core platform. The integration allows real-time brand impact analysis across global markets within existing Trade Desk workflows. Advertisers can run and measure Brand Lift in one place, which aims to simplify campaign planning and post campaign evaluation. items.title: 3 Value Stocks That Fall Short
items.summary: Value stocks typically trade at discounts to the broader market, offering patient investors the opportunity to buy businesses when they’re out of favor. The key risk, however, is that these stocks are usually cheap for a reason, and a low valuation can reflect underlying business challenges rather than a genuine bargain.
